title: Daily content contract hard gate PR1
summary: Project iteration record for turning the 2026-06-17 weak-content feedback into executable daily content contracts before changing generators. This PR records the contract, adds deterministic red/green coverage, wires a no-network smoke gate into validation, and keeps PR2-PR5 responsible for generator fixes.

lessons.lesson: Repair output cannot be the definition of a successful daily report.
lessons.evidence: The user explicitly clarified that repair is only a fallback; the generation strategy and source-specific selection rules must produce useful public content before repair.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep content quality requirements in machine-checkable contracts and make each generator PR prove it satisfies its section before publish.

lessons.lesson: A contract gate must separate blocking content failures from degraded source availability.
lessons.evidence: REQ-001, REQ-006, REQ-007, and REQ-008 are blocking; REQ-010 can degrade for missing official snapshots, but fake OpenRouter or Artificial Analysis components are blocking.
lessons.recommended_action: Use the content-contract checker after build and before dry-run so publish cannot mistake fake content for degraded source availability.

suggestions.issue: The project lacked one executable place to replay thin main bullets, weak GitHub Trending summaries, filler hot blogs, empty Builder/X selections, and fake tracking components.
suggestions.evidence: The new checker and tests replay the 2026-06-17 weak shape and distinguish blocking issues from degraded tracking-source absence.
suggestions.suggestion: Evaluate final report JSON and optional HTML for daily content contracts before publish, and expose blocking/degraded summaries in machine-readable output.
suggestions.expected_benefit: Future generator changes can fail early with precise section codes instead of relying on chat memory or post-hoc repair.
suggestions.promotion_path: Implemented as a committed script, npm validation smoke gate, harness rule, feedback ledger item, and unit tests.
validation_evidence: daily content contract rejects 2026-06-17 weak generated shape
daily content contract accepts aligned generated shape
harness requires content contract validation for daily content contract tasks

followups.action: Implement PR2-PR5 so report:draft, discovery, rendering, and publish runner satisfy the new content contract on real generated artifacts.
